# Generated by tools/build_frontier_design.py; edit the generator.
on_startup = {
	# An older save can contain an orphaned muster in a conquered province.
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = cossack_host_founded } }
		rip_host_clear_musters_effect = yes
	}
	rip_host_network_upkeep_effect = yes
	rip_frontier_expedition_upkeep_effect = yes
}

on_monthly_pulse = {
	rip_host_network_upkeep_effect = yes
	rip_frontier_expedition_upkeep_effect = yes
}

on_reform_changed = {
	rip_host_network_upkeep_effect = yes
	rip_frontier_expedition_upkeep_effect = yes
}

on_province_owner_change = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_province_modifier = cossack_host_muster }
		remove_province_modifier = cossack_host_muster
	}
	rip_expedition_clear_province_effect = yes
}
